newsitem.title: USA: FSA qualifies four muni issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: FSA qualifies four muni issues for bond insurance.

text.p: Financial Security Assurance said Thursday it qualified for bond insurance the following four municipal issues slated for competitive sale today:
--Wynne School District No 9, Ark., $1.8 million refunding and construction bonds.
--Omaha Public Power District, Neb., $80 million revenue bonds.
--Hillsborough Board Education, N.J., $39 million school bonds.
--Monmouth High School Board of Education, N.J., $6.995 million school bonds.
